text: This staff report concerns a matter for which the Etobicoke York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to advise Community Council concerning an application by the property owner of 63 Glenaden Avenue East. for a site-specific Fence Exemption, pursuant to Section 447-1.5(B) of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 447 – Fences. The property owner is seeking Community Council’s permission to construct a wood fence (trellis) on the East side of the property measuring 3.23 meters in height that extends along the length of the deck for approximately 5.57 meters (3 panels).

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Granted the application for a fence exemption permit to the property owner of 63 Glenaden Avenue East, thereby allowing the property owner to erect and maintain a wood fence (trellis) on the East side of the property which currently measures 3.23 meters in height. Also, to direct and require the rear yard fence(s) to be maintained in good repair without alteration. At such time as replacement of the fence (trellis) is required, the installation will comply with Municipal Code Chapter 447, Fences, or its successor by-law.
